question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word:

INTRANSIGENCE
solution:
The correct answer is: **Stubbornness**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Intransigence"** refers to an unwillingness to change one's views or to agree about something; it suggests a rigid or unyielding attitude. (अड़ियलपन)

 
 
• **Example:** His intransigence during the negotiations led to the breakdown of the deal.
